notes: Community car: the forum loop is closed end to end. The console's community view now filters GitHub Discussions by category locally (GitHub ignores the upstream parameter, so the console never trusts it), the new TASK HALL card reads the task board through the same shared server cache, VIEW ALL scopes the list to the board and "All categories" restores it, the category dropdown is the union of loaded rows and the GraphQL category list (a zero-post category stays selectable and renders its honest empty state), and NEW TASK opens the composer with the task board preselected — a missing category or a missing token is an honest hint, never a dead form. SNIFF grew a fourth source kind, discussions: an anonymous read of this product's own public forum, filtered locally by category slug, yielding tasks/latest readings with no token ever attached; task detection is notification-only and participation stays in-conversation (owner adjudication: capability plus notification, no autonomous posting). The car also fixed a latent sniff engine bug — the tick overwrote its previous-sweep baseline before evaluating rules, so the changed operator could never fire in production; the baseline now lands after evaluation, with tick-level regression legs. The forum itself went live: a welcome announcement plus a code-of-conduct post for each of the seven sub-forums, the Task Hall post carrying the no-responsibility disclaimer, and the Task Hall category itself. Verification: core 2137/2137, console smoke 509/509, locale packs 1392 keys per language, and the community probe extended to 86/86.
